responsibility: Declares the small external interface to the hard-register copy-propagation pass. In this module it chiefly exposes the helper that runs forward hard-register copy propagation on a single basic block without touching debug insns, allowing nearby RTL code to reuse the propagation logic without depending on the full pass driver in regcprop.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header is limited to the exported helper for block-local hard-register copy propagation without debug-insn updates. The same-stem source gcc/regcprop.cc contains the full propagation engine, value-state machinery, debug handling, and pass registration.
